model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма илюстрира връзката между степента на разреждане и перплексността, като сравнява две категории: "Per-Output" и "Per-Layer". Хоризонталната ос показва степените на разреждане, етикетирани от 10% до 80% на интервали от 10%, като не се наблюдава конкретен ред или скала освен равномерното разпределение на категориите. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като "Perplexity" и има скала със стойности от $10^1$ до $10^3$, като показва логаритмична скала. Като цяло, както "Per-Output", така и "Per-Layer" категориите показват тенденция на нарастване на перплексността с увеличаване на степента на разреждане. Представителни стойности за "Per-Output" при 10% разреждане са близо до $10^1$, докато при 80% са малко над $10^2$. За "Per-Layer", при 10% разреждане стойностите са също близо до $10^1$, а при 80% са малко под $10^3$. Няма групиране или наслагване на стълбите освен двете категории, които са ясно разграничени чрез цветовете си в легендата. Няма подчертаване чрез удебеляване или засенчване на някой от стълбите.
model_annotations.Chinese: The figure presents a bar graph illustrating the relationship between Perplexity and Sparsity Rate, comparing two categories: Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the Sparsity Rate, ranging from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with a linear scale. The vertical axis represents Perplexity, labeled with values from 10^1 to 10^3 in logarithmic scale, with numerical tick marks at 10, 10^2, and 10^3. The graph features two sets of bars, colored blue for Per-Output and orange for Per-Layer. Each set consists of eight bars, with the Per-Output bars having approximate heights of 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 40, and 500, and the Per-Layer bars having approximate heights of 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 60, and 1000, corresponding to the Sparsity Rates from 10% to 80%, respectively. The bars are grouped by Sparsity Rate, with Per-Output on the left and Per-Layer on the right. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no visual emphasis is applied to any of the bars.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two categories, Per-Output and Per-Layer. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, labeled with percentages from 10% to 80% in increments of 10%, with no indicated scale type. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled with values ranging from 10^0 to 10^3 on a logarithmic scale, with no units provided. The chart features two sets of bars, one for Per-Output in blue and one for Per-Layer in orange. For Per-Output, the approximate perplexity values are: 2 at 10%, 2.5 at 20%, 3 at 30%, 3.5 at 40%, 4 at 50%, 5 at 60%, 20 at 70%, and 600 at 80%. For Per-Layer, the approximate values are: 2 at 10%, 2.5 at 20%, 3 at 30%, 3.5 at 40%, 4 at 50%, 5 at 60%, 50 at 70%, and 1000 at 80%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order beyond the increasing sparsity rate and do not exhibit visual emphasis beyond color differentiation according to the legend. The bars for Per-Output and Per-Layer are grouped side-by-side for each sparsity rate, allowing for direct comparison between the two categories.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt den Zusammenhang zwischen Perplexity und Sparsity Rate für zwei Methoden: Per-Output und Per-Layer. Die x-Achse stellt die Sparsity Rate in Prozent dar und ist in gleichmäßige Intervalle von 10% unterteilt, von 10% bis 80%. Die y-Achse stellt die Perplexity dar und ist logarithmisch skaliert, mit Werten von $10^1$ bis $10^3$. Die Balken für Per-Output sind blau, während die Balken für Per-Layer orange sind. Jeder Balken stellt den ungefähren Wert der Perplexity für eine bestimmte Sparsity Rate dar. Die niedrigsten Werte für beide Methoden liegen bei einer Sparsity Rate von 10%, mit Per-Output bei ungefähr 3 und Per-Layer bei ungefähr 3. Die Werte nehmen mit steigender Sparsity Rate zu, wobei Per-Layer bei einer Sparsity Rate von 80% den höchsten Wert von ungefähr 600 erreicht, während Per-Output bei derselben Rate einen Wert von ungefähr 400 aufweist. Die Balken sind in aufsteigender Reihenfolge der Sparsity Rate angeordnet, ohne besondere Hervorhebung einzelner Balken.
